verdict.rationale: LightSprint claims you can clear a bug backlog with background cloud agents. Tasks can come in from Slack, Linear or Jira, run in isolated per-task sandboxes, and arrive in Review Hub as PRs with a merge-readiness score. However, the bug-fixing claim is a single marketing line, and nothing describes how the agent diagnoses a reported bug. missing for 10: documented autonomous diagnosis and root-cause workflow, detailed bug-fix docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent autonomously diagnose and fix a reported bug

citations.quote: Clear your bug backlog with background cloud agents
Create LightSprint tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira.
every task on your board its own full-stack environment: an isolated sandbox with a branched database when needed
Track each pull request in Review Hub, where engineers can check readiness and merge.
